description: Place the prepared order only after explicit user confirmation of details and terms. Requires orders.execute scope; identity determines payment authority. Retrying the SAME intent never authorizes another order. Do not replace an indeterminate intent with a new one. Payment: omit pay_with to use the default shown in the prepared summary (payment.default). Pass pay_with (gateway, cash or coin) and, for gateway, channel only when the buyer chose a method that appears in payment.options; a method that is not listed is refused. Signed-in accounts: gateway_fallback=true only when the buyer agreed up front that a payment link with the same total may be created if the balance turns out short; the result state payment_choice_required means nothing was created or debited and the buyer must be asked again (then pass the pay_with named in its message).
name: execute_purchase
title: Buat pesanan setelah dikonfirmasi
